The '''Garos system''' was a six-planet [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="AGoH" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was located near the [[Nyarikan Nebula/Legends|Nyarikan Nebula]].<ref name="TP">{{JournalCite|5|Turning Point (Charlene Newcomb)}}</ref>
